summary: The acceptance candidate is not independently reproducible from its documented environment. The production U-Net dependency and pytest are absent from the root requirements, so the documented installation cannot run the production model or validation command; the focused pytest command failed with `No module named pytest`. Device selection is automatic and no deterministic inference policy or cross-device equivalence test is present. In addition, the user guide still directs operators to obsolete v5.7 profile/checkpoint locations. Static inspection did confirm that the implemented GUI, CLI, tuner, and study launchers select v5.7.1 code; the production profile resolves successfully and the committed checkpoint hash matches.

findings.title: Documented environment omits dependencies required for production and validation
findings.impact: A clean user following the repository instructions cannot run the dual-head production checkpoint or reproduce the claimed automated validation. This directly blocks software-reproducibility acceptance.
evidence: README.md:117-129 documents installation from requirements.txt followed by pytest.
requirements.txt:1-12 omits both torch and pytest.
utils/saturn_unet25d_bridge.py:109-129 imports torch to load the production checkpoint.
The focused pytest command exited 1 with `No module named pytest`.
unet25d/requirements.txt:6 contains torch only in a separate, undocumented-for-production dependency file.
findings.recommendation: Provide one pinned, production-supported environment specification containing torch and test dependencies, document supported Python/device versions, and reproduce the full and focused validation commands in a clean environment.

findings.title: Production inference is not specified or tested as deterministic across device paths
findings.impact: The same stack can automatically execute on CUDA, MPS, or CPU without a recorded deterministic policy. Device-dependent probability differences near fixed thresholds can change segmentation, tracking, and reports, undermining reproducibility across supported platforms.
evidence: utils/saturn_unet25d_bridge.py:45-51 delegates to automatic device selection.
unet25d/torch_device.py:31-35 chooses CUDA, MPS, or CPU based on availability.
No deterministic PyTorch configuration was found in the production bridge.
tests/test_torch_device.py:36-48 tests selection only; it does not compare production checkpoint outputs or thresholded results across devices.
findings.recommendation: Make inference device an explicit serialized runtime setting, record torch/platform/device versions in output provenance, define deterministic backend behavior, and add repeated-inference plus cross-device tolerance tests using the production checkpoint.

findings.title: Operator guide selects obsolete profile and checkpoint paths
findings.impact: An operator following the documented workflow may run a historical v5.7 configuration instead of the reviewed v5.7.1 production candidate, so GUI/study behavior is not reliably tied to the audited defaults.
evidence: USER_GUIDE.md:90-101 names the historical v5.7 tuning profile and `checkpoints\epoch_003.pt`.
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:16163-16167 defines production_profiles/saturn_v5_7_1_model_c_epoch003.json.
scripts/run_v571_study.py:8-12 defines the same v5.7.1 profile and pipeline.
findings.recommendation: Replace historical instructions with the exact v5.7.1 profile and checkpoint, include the expected SHA-256, and add a documentation/launcher test that executes profile loading rather than searching source strings.

findings.title: Entry-point tests provide false confidence through source-string assertions
findings.impact: Renamed, unreachable, or behaviorally divergent study/tuner code can still pass because the test only checks that expected filenames appear in source text.
evidence: tests/test_saturn_v571_audit_blockers.py:239-248 reads launcher source and asserts three strings.
The test never calls scripts/run_v571_study.py load_config/main or the tuner GUI command builder.
Focused pytest execution was unavailable, leaving integration paths independently unverified.
findings.recommendation: Add subprocess or import-level integration tests for default and custom profiles across GUI preflight, single slice, batch, tuner, study manager, and command-line launchers, including generated settings/report assertions and failure cases.

findings.title: Acceptance audit inputs are untracked
findings.impact: The exact acceptance-candidate audit invocation is not represented by a clean repository state and can be lost or changed independently of the reviewed commit.
evidence: `git status --short --untracked-files=all` reported audits/runs/20260821-v571-post-remediation-final/claim_snapshot.json, manifest.json, and prompt files as untracked.
The tracked source tree itself showed no modification.
findings.recommendation: Have the release steward preserve the append-only audit-run inputs and final records according to repository policy before making a release decision.

limitations: No full image stack was run, as explicitly prohibited.
Other reviewers' outputs were not opened or used.
The focused suite could not run because pytest is unavailable in the documented environment; conclusions about those tests are based on source inspection and the concrete command failure.
GUI windows and accelerator-specific inference could not be exercised in this headless CPU-oriented review environment.
The ignored full-specimen replay directory exists under scratch/v571_remediation_final2_pilot, but its full image outputs were not executed or exhaustively inspected.
recommended_follow_up: Create and test a clean pinned production environment, then rerun the documented full suite and the focused entry-point/report suite.
Add executable integration coverage for GUI preflight, single-slice, batch, tuner GUI/CLI, study GUI/CLI, resume/cache invalidation, and report serialization.
Record device and software provenance and demonstrate deterministic repeated inference or documented tolerances on CPU, CUDA, and MPS where claimed supported.
Correct USER_GUIDE.md to identify the audited v5.7.1 profile, checkpoint, and SHA-256.
Run a superseding independent software-reproducibility audit after remediation; a conditional verdict would still not pass the gate.
